translations.web: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
translations.bsb: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
translations.kjv: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
translations.asv: But I am poor and needy; Yet the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God. Psalm 41 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
